text:
Maria: rolling canary v0.72 -> v0.73 to east-us-prod and seeing immediate OOMs on most longctx instances :grimacing:
Jonathan: got the same alerts, stacktrace points at KV growth after autobatch coalescing change (PR #4021)
Kevin: is that the kernel_selector rewrite or the autobatch handoff tweak?
Maria: both landed in the same window; autobatch handoff (4021) and new kernel routing table (4033) are in the canary
Anya: FYI CI flagged a kv_cache perf regression yesterday but it was marked as intermittent
ci-bot: CI FAILURE: tests/runtime/kv_cache_integration.py::test_fragmentation_model (run 2480001200) — mem spike >98% on 16k seq emulation
Jonathan: pasted a log snippet:

```
2026-03-18T10:12:03Z runtime INFO kv_cache: shard=7 prefetch=64 used=1.2G avail=256M
2026-03-18T10:12:04Z kernel_router DEBUG select_kernel: seq_len=16384 chosen=fast_attn_q8
2026-03-18T10:12:04Z kv_cache WARN slab_alloc: requested=128M, fragment=91% -> falling back to growth
2026-03-18T10:12:05Z runtime ERROR OOM: allocation failed, attempt=3
```
Kevin: fragment=91% — classic slab fragmentation / alignment issue
Maria: repro steps: `scripts/harness/regress_longctx.sh --model gpt-like --seq 16k --concurrency 2` reproduces OOM reliably
Anya: uploaded heap profile: https://perf.redwood/internal/heap/2480001234 — lots of ~512k free fragments pinned by KV prefix refs
Jonathan: autobatcher is combining many small requests into a few very large frames; that triggers a different kernel path which allocates larger KV pages
Kevin: kernel_selector switching to fast_attn_q8 likely expects contiguous KV pages; reallocs plus reduced LRU pressure -> fragmentation
Anya: noticed eviction window got reduced in the same patchset, so evictions didn't kick in early
Maria: hypothesis: autobatch -> larger combined seqs -> kernel route to q8 -> alloc pattern shifts -> fragmentation -> OOMs
ops-bot: Rollout paused for canary group longctx-eus (12 instances) at 2026-03-18T10:25:00Z by ops
Jonathan: starting bisect between merges 4021 (autobatch) and 4033 (kernel routing), will report which commit flips behavior
Kevin: short mitigation: increase eviction aggressiveness and pin kernel routing to legacy for seq > 8k
Maria: I have a hotfix candidate: `runtime: force kernel=legacy_attn for seq>=8192` — quick local smoke passed 10 runs without OOM
Anya: we need a CI regression that simulates autobatch coalescing with mixed seq lengths
ci-bot: TEST CREATED: tests/runtime/kv_autobatch_mixed_seq.py by @Jonathan (ticket INF-2819)
Jonathan: bisect update at 10:40 — root cause is 4021 (autobatch handoff heuristic). 4033 amplifies but is not the primary cause
Kevin: plan: revert 4021 from canary, push hotfix kernel pin, then rework autobatch behavior off-line
Maria: reverting canary now
ops-bot: Revert submitted: PR #4045 (revert autobatch handoff heuristic) by Maria — rollback initiated
Anya: postmortem actions: add synthetic longctx memory frag checks to CI and a perf test for mixed 8k-16k traffic
Maria: follow-ups: 1) revert landed 2) add perf test 3) investigate slab allocator alignment + eviction window interplay
Kevin: I'll own slab alignment investigation; Jonathan will lead autobatch redesign; Anya adds CI test + dashboards
Maria: marking this thread as rollout-blocker and linking to incident INC-892
Jonathan: will close loop once a non-revert patch passes the new perf test, ETA 2 business days
Maria: :thumbsup:
